invariants.rationale: The method always returns a String, and neither branch returns null.
Both return sites generate a non-empty String: either from getName() or by building a description including class and properties.
If getName() returns null, the method builds a string containing ':', otherwise result is the name.
If getName() is non-null, result is exactly that; otherwise, it is a composite string containing the class name and a colon.
Result is always a non-empty string, as both cases return non-empty values.
